cd /workspace/tmp/t && cat > t_last.py << 'PYEOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/t')
from harness import *

# idle fires at start of a datagram that would be LAYOUT -> CONNECTION_CLOSED, not LAYOUT
r = R([dg(1,[pk("I",0,[PING])]), dg(50,[pk("A",0,[PING]), pk("I",1,[PING])])], idle_ms=10)
check('U1 idle beats layout', r['packets'],
      [(0,0,'accepted','OK',1,None),(1,0,'dropped','CONNECTION_CLOSED',50,None),(1,1,'dropped','CONNECTION_CLOSED',50,None)])
# error mid-datagram then remaining packets
r = R([KA, dg(1,[pk("I",0,[UNK]), pk("I",1,[PING]), pk("A",2,[PING])])])
check('U2 error mid datagram', r['packets'],
      [(0,0,'error','FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR',1,0),(0,1,'dropped','CONNECTION_CLOSED',1,None),(0,2,'dropped','CONNECTION_CLOSED',1,None)])
# layout checked once, at datagram start while open
r = R([KA, dg(1,[pk("I",0,[CL(False,1)]), pk("I",1,[PING]), pk("A",2,[PING])])])
check('U3 close then rest', r['packets'],
      [(0,0,'accepted','OK',1,None),(0,1,'dropped','CONNECTION_CLOSED',1,None),(0,2,'dropped','CONNECTION_CLOSED',1,None)])
# pending dropped at termination inside same datagram processing
r = R([dg(1,[pk("H",0,[PING])]), dg(2,[pk("I",0,[UNK])])], buffer_packets=4)
check('U4 pending dropped by later error', r['packets'],
      [(0,0,'dropped','CONNECTION_CLOSED',2,None),(1,0,'error','FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR',2,0)])
# key discard then buffered records order
r = R([dg(1,[pk("H",0,[PING]), pk("H",1,[PING])]), dg(2,[pk("H",2,[PING])]), key(3,"H","install")], buffer_packets=2)
check('U5 order across events', r['packets'],
      [(0,0,'accepted','OK',3,None),(0,1,'accepted','OK',3,None),(1,0,'dropped','BUFFER_FULL',2,None)])
# zero buffer with live key -> normal processing
r = R([dg(1,[pk("I",0,[PING])])], buffer_packets=0)
check('U6 zero buffer live key', r['packets'], [(0,0,'accepted','OK',1,None)])
# stop_sending entry only
r = R([KA, A(0,[SS(0)])])
check('U7 stop only entry', (r['streams'], r['total']), ([(0,0,None,False,True,'')], 0))
# reset only entry
r = R([KA, A(0,[RS(0,0)])])
check('U8 reset zero entry', (r['streams'], r['total']), ([(0,0,0,True,False,'')], 0))
